docs.title: Welcome
docs.text:
Welcome Welcome to our book group!

The first Tuesday of each month at 7:00pm, the St. John Vianney Women’s Book Group gathers in SJV's Room 11 with wine and chocolate to discuss a book that's been chosen by our group.

Everyone is welcome! No need to bring anything, and you don't even need to read the book to join us.

Questions? Reach out to Angela Bartz at abartzmail@gmail.com.

Note: Book choices may change if library waitlists are unusually long. Check this site for the latest selections.
